project.title: Self-Service AWS Service Catalog Products
project.role: AWS Cloud Infrastructure as Code DevOps Engineer & Architect

parentsummary.deliverables: Built an organization-shared AWS Service Catalog portfolio of versioned CloudFormation blueprint products (3-tier web application, backup and archival) and operational products (monitoring, encryption) with launch constraints.
parentsummary.outcomes: Reduced infrastructure deployment time for workload teams from weeks for new AWS users—and days for quicker teams—down to hours using pre-approved catalogue products.

challenge.summary: Many early adopter workload teams were new to AWS and provisioned cloud infrastructure by hand through the web console. Without repeatable, pre-approved templates, this manual approach caused slow onboarding, inconsistent builds, and non-compliant resources.

deliverables: Created an AWS Service Catalog portfolio shared across the AWS Organization so workload teams could self-serve pre-approved infrastructure
Built reusable blueprint products for a 3-tier web application and for backup and archival
Built operational monitoring products for AWS CloudWatch configuration and a syslog forwarder
Packaged operational encryption products providing AWS Key Management Service (KMS) customer managed keys with their key policies and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles
Authored the catalogue products as versioned AWS CloudFormation templates
Applied AWS Service Catalog launch constraints so workload teams could deploy products without holding broad IAM permissions
Wrote documentation and onboarding guides for workload teams

outcomes: Infrastructure deployments that previously took weeks for teams new to AWS, and days for quicker teams, were reduced to hours using catalogue products
Workload teams shifted from manual console provisioning to standard, pre-approved catalogue products
